about_the_game:
Welcome to Fronteeland!

Are you ready to dive into a pure, retro, and exhilarating hack-and-slash adventure? In Fronteeland, you play as a lone hero venturing into a forgotten, chaotic land. There are no complex plots, no tedious quests—only endless combat and a primal will to survive. Your goal is simple: pick up your weapon and fight your way out!

Weapons Are Your Only Friends

In this harsh border wasteland, the law of survival is simple: fight, and live. We have prepared a vast arsenal for you, and you'll stumble upon these weapons in the heat of battle.

From heavy greatswords that can cleave enemies in two to longswords that unleash swift combos; from longbows that keep you at a safe distance to spears that can sweep through entire armies—each weapon has a unique feel, attack style, and tactical value.

You are not bound to a single weapon. You can pick up new ones at any time during combat. Whether you choose to steadily wear down an enemy with a longsword or switch to a warhammer for a risky, devastating blow is a split-second decision that's all yours.

Key Features

  • Dynamic, On-the-Fly Weapon System: The battlefield is ever-changing, and so should your arsenal. Pick up new weapons from the ground at any moment to instantly change your combat style and turn a disadvantage into an advantage. Use every weapon to its fullest before it breaks!

  • A Vast, Unlockable Arsenal: As you battle on, you'll unlock dozens of weapons, each with distinct characteristics, greatly enriching your combat choices and replayability.

  • In-Game Relics: With over 50 relics to discover, use their power boosts to defeat even stronger foes.

  • Earn Gold for Stronger Armor: Even the bravest warrior needs powerful armor. Purchase the gear you desire in the safety of your base camp!

  • Unlock More Playable Characters: Unlock a variety of playable characters to experience different combat styles.

  • Endless Challenges: Delve into diverse levels and face increasingly cunning and formidable enemies. Only the strongest warriors will conquer Fronteeland.
